observations: Three photos show two car headlight assemblies wrapped in clear plastic, lying on a concrete floor.
The headlamps have a black housing with orange turn signal sections and visible mounting brackets.
The plastic wrap is crinkled and shows signs of handling, with some dirt and wear.
No brand or model markings are visible on the headlamps themselves in any photo.
The watermark 'LINUS AUTO LIGHT SOLUTION' is present on all photos.
The seller claims these are 'Direct tokunbo Honda fancy light All models available' and 'Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.'

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers on the headlamps in any photo. The term 'tokunbo' (imported second-hand) is plausible, but not verifiable from photos alone.
No model-specific features or part numbers are visible. The claim cannot be verified without additional context or proof of compatibility.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlamps may not be compatible with any Honda model, or may be from a different brand than claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number or model-specific markings on the headlamps, or a photo showing the headlamps installed on a Honda vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used headlamps, not as Honda-specific or Toyota parts

risks.risk: The headlamps may be damaged or non-functional despite being wrapped in plastic.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the headlamps turned on, or a close-up of the internal bulb sockets and wiring.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may hide cracks, scratches, or damage to the lens or housing.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the headlamps without plastic wrap, showing the entire surface.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential cosmetic damage

proof_requests: A clear photo of the part number or model markings on the headlamps.
A video or photo showing the headlamps turned on.
A close-up photo of the headlamps without plastic wrap, showing the entire surface.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
